STEP 1 - Scene: A fruit-and-chia-pudding plate, with white fruit pieces and browned cooked fruit.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A large square plate, roughly 25 cm across; treating it as an equivalent 25 cm diameter gives an area of about 491 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: Chia pudding, blueberries, banana pieces, and browned cooked fruit (likely apple). No visible oil, dressing, or sauce.

STEP 4 - Area: Chia pudding ~12%, blueberries ~12%, banana ~10%, cooked fruit ~9%; together about 43% of the plate.

STEP 5 - Volume: Chia pudding: 59 cm² × 1.8 cm ≈ 106 ml. Blueberries: 59 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 118 ml. Banana: 49 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 74 ml. Cooked fruit: 44 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 88 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Using bulk densities of about 0.8 g/ml for pudding and 0.6 g/ml for fruit: pudding ~85 g, blueberries ~71 g, banana ~44 g, cooked fruit ~53 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: At approximately 120, 57, 89, and 60 kcal per 100 g respectively, that is about 102 + 40 + 39 + 32 = 213 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The visible portions look like a modest meal, and an estimate around 250 g and 210 kcal is plausible.
